name: Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund Postdoctoral Fellowship
funder: Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund for Medical Research
amount: USD 50,000/year stipend + USD 1,000 per child + USD 2,000/year lab research allowance
other_rules: Generally no more than 1 year of postdoc experience (2+ years only in exceptional cases)
MD applicants within 3 years of degree
any citizenship, but foreign nationals must train in the US (US citizens may go abroad)
notes: Cancer biology and basic biomedical research. Deadline 1 February each year. Fellows starting after a year of postdoc usually get 2 years.
